Why the backend cannot tell What can the backend actually see? This is what makes the relay work, and what a mitigation has to change. The certificate chain proves that a key lives in genuine secure hardware on a locked, verified device, and that this hardware saw our challenge. It does not prove which phone is talking to the backend right now. There is no field in the KeyDescription that binds the attestation to the transport, the session, or the device presenting it. The nonce is the only freshness signal, and we forwarded it faithfully. From the backend's chair, a relayed chain and a local chain are the same bytes. This is the same shape as the Remote Key Attestation that Guardsquare documented 1, a chain produced on one device and presented from another. Unlike the variants they describe, ours hides no keybox and patches no boot chain. It forwards a real attestation from a real clean device, bound to the real challenge, nothing more. Where the simple relay stops Our relay leans on two things the backend fails to do, and naming them points straight at the mitigations. The first is decisive. The backend never checks which app the chain was issued to. Our chain is produced on the clean phone by a different app than the target, and the attestation says so. The app identity is written into the certificate under attestationApplicationId. Our backend simply never reads it. The moment it does, and compares that field to the app it expects, the chain we built is rejected. That single check is where our relay stops, and it is the cheapest of all. The second is deeper. The relay assumes attestation is a one-shot gate. The app attests once, at launch or during login, the backend validates the chain and the nonce, grants access, and moves on. That assumption holds surprisingly often, and when it does the relay is enough. It breaks the moment the backend asks the client to prove, later in the same session, that it holds the attested private key. The attested key lives on the clean phone, not on our rooted one. We relayed a chain, not a key. If the backend sends a fresh value to sign with that key and checks the signature, our test device cannot answer on its own. We would have to relay signing operations too, keeping the clean phone in the loop for every signed message. The one-shot courier becomes a live proxy, heavier and far more fragile, but not stopped. Both are seams a defender can press on. We take them up in the next section, the decisive and cheap one first. Mitigation We now switch chairs and look at the relay from the backend side. The question is simple. What check would have stopped our own bypass? We take the mitigations cheapest first, and we keep each one honest. For every proposal we say what it forces the attacker to do, and what it does not solve. One caveat up front. The first mitigation has been tested against our own relay. Its code, however, does not ship with this article. The companion backend leaves it out on purpose, so the relay has a gate to walk through. We ran the check separately and confirmed it rejects the relayed chain. The second is a design proposal. We reason about it and point at the standards it rests on, but we did not build it and we did not test it. We flag this again in each section and in the synthesis table, so the reader can tell a tested control from a blueprint. It is worth being clear about what the relay exploits. It is not a weakness in the attestation mechanism. The chain we relayed is genuine, the signatures are valid, the hardware told the truth. What let us through is a backend that validated the chain without checking who it was issued to. The relay worked because of two gaps. The chain carries the identity of the app that requested the attestation, but the baseline backend never checks it against the app it expects to be talking to. It certifies a key the client is never asked to use, so a chain relayed from another device is never challenged. The first gap is the real one, and closing it is the real mitigation. The second only raises the analyst's cost. We take them in that order. Bind the attestation to your app The attestation extension already carries the identity of the app that generated the key. The attestationApplicationId field, tag [709] in the AuthorizationList, holds the package name, the SHA-256 digests of the app's signing certificates, and the version code 214. Our backend never reads it. Google's own issuance guidance is explicit that the package name and signature come from the holder and must be obtained and checked independently 20. That omission is what lets the relay pass, because the chain came from a different app. Its value is a DER-encoded structure, nested inside the extension 1514: AttestationApplicationId ::= SEQUENCE { packageInfos SET OF AttestationPackageInfo, signatureDigests SET OF OCTET_STRING, } AttestationPackageInfo ::= SEQUENCE { packageName OCTET_STRING, version INTEGER, } It is tempting to picture the app identity as a field the client sends next to the chain. That is not where it lives. It sits under tag [709], inside the same attestation extension as the challenge and the root of trust, and the backend parses it out of the certificate. packageName is the app package name, signatureDigests are the SHA-256 digests of the app's signing certificates. The platform fills both from the app that called generateKey, so on a device with a healthy boot state the caller cannot choose them. There is a catch, and it is the reason this check is placed first but not alone. attestationApplicationId lives in the softwareEnforced list, populated by the Android platform, not by the secure hardware. A software-enforced value can be trusted only as long as the device that produced it runs an operating system that complies with the Android Platform Security Model, that is, its bootloader is locked and its verifiedBootState is Verified 2. On a directly rooted phone, with no relay, a compromised platform could write anything here. That caveat is exactly why the check works against the relay. Our backend already rejects any chain whose hardware-enforced RootOfTrust does not report a locked, verified device. if attestation["device_locked"] is not True: return "Bootloader is unlocked (deviceLocked is false)" if state != "Verified": return f"Verified Boot state is {state}, expected Verified" Once that check passes, the chain was generated on a device whose OS satisfies the security model. On such a device the softwareEnforced values are trustworthy. So the two checks compose. The hardware-enforced boot state vouches for the platform, and the now-trustworthy platform vouches for the app identity. Concretely, the backend adds one comparison after parsing the extension. # Illustrative. Not yet implemented in attestation_backend.py. EXPECTED_PACKAGE = "com.quarkslab.attestation.demo" EXPECTED_SIGNER_SHA256 = "…" # SHA-256 of our release signing certificate if attestation["application_package"] != EXPECTED_PACKAGE: return "Attestation was generated by a different application" if EXPECTED_SIGNER_SHA256 not in attestation["application_signatures"]: return "Attestation application signature does not match" In our relay the chain is produced by the clean oracle, which runs com.quarkslab.attestation.server. Its honest platform writes that package and its own signing digest into the field. The comparison fails and the chain is rejected. The analyst cannot repackage around it either. A clean verified-boot OS will report the true identity, and the signing certificate digest cannot be matched without the target's private signing key. We added this check in a separate test and it rejected the relayed chain. This single comparison kills the cross-app relay we built, even though the shipped backend leaves it out on purpose. It does not, on its own, prove device integrity. Treat it as a binding to your app, not as an integrity signal, and always pair it with the hardware-enforced boot state check above. Bind the attestation to a live key The app check closes the relay we demonstrated. Could a determined analyst still get past it? Only by producing the attestation from a clean instance of the very same app, so that the package and the signing digest match. That is harder than it sounds. It means driving the real target app, on a clean and verified device, to attest a challenge the analyst chooses and to hand back the raw chain. A clean verified device is exactly the kind you cannot instrument. There is no easy way to inject the nonce or to export the chain. Rooting that device to instrument it would break its verified boot state and fail the attestation. Short of a keybox or a TEE bug, which is the hardware path we set aside, the same-app relay stays out of reach. Suppose the analyst gets there anyway. The deeper problem is that the backend inspects a certificate and never asks the client to use the key it certifies. The fix is proof of possession. After a valid attestation, the backend requires the client to sign a fresh server challenge with the attested private key, inside the same session, and it verifies the signature 16. This is the assertion step that mobile attestation designs place after attestation, the same attestation-then-assertion pattern used by hardware-backed authenticators 17. This does not close the relay. The attested key lives on the clean device, so the analyst answers the proof by relaying every signing operation to it. The one-shot courier becomes a live proxy that must stay online for the whole session. That is an operational cost, latency on every signature and a device that has to stay reachable, not a barrier. It slows the analyst down, it does not lock them out. We describe this mitigation, we do not ship it. The companion backend implements only the app binding above. Proof of possession is a design proposal here, reasoned but not implemented and not tested against our relay. Proof of possession only raises the cost for an attacker who has somehow already cleared that bar. Conclusion We set out to do two things. Understand what Android hardware attestation proves, and get past it when it blocks an analysis. Both are done, and they point at the same lesson. The mechanism itself is sound. A key generated in a TEE or a StrongBox is signed by a key the device cannot choose or forge, the chain climbs to a Google root, and the RootOfTrust reports the boot state without asking the platform for permission. On our rooted phone that machinery worked exactly as designed. It told the truth, and the truth locked us out. There was no cryptography to break, and we did not try. What we broke was an assumption. The backend treated a signed certificate as proof that the phone in front of it was healthy. It is not. It is proof that some phone, somewhere, has healthy hardware and once saw our challenge. We supplied that phone. A clean device answered the attestation, its genuine chain traveled back through a Frida hook, and the backend validated a device it had never met. We changed neither the key nor the boot state. We changed who got asked. That is the moral, and it is not specific to attestation. A hardware guarantee is only as strong as the protocol that consumes it. Attestation certifies a key, on a device, at a moment in time. It says nothing about which app requested it or whether that key is ever used again. A backend that reads only "valid chain, healthy device" and opens the gate has turned a hardware guarantee into a formality. Closing the gap does not call for better silicon. It calls for the backend to bind the attestation to the app that asked. That check is cheap and unglamorous, which is probably why it is so often skipped. blocks.html_en: Hardware key attestation lets an Android app prove to its backend that a key lives in secure hardware on a locked, verified device. It is also the wall that stops a security analyst working on a rooted phone. This article opens the mechanism from the analyst's chair, from the certificate chain and the attestation extension down to the root of trust, then shows a simple bypass that never touches the secure hardware. We relay the attestation to a clean device and splice a genuine chain back into the target app with a Frida hook. A companion repository ships the validation backend, the demo apps and the instrumentation, so the whole setup can be run and inspected rather than taken on faith.

blocks.html_en: For a security analyst, this is a familiar wall. Our mission phone is usually rooted. That is not an accident, it is the job. The app asks the hardware for a signed statement about the device, the hardware honestly reports a broken root of trust, and the backend rejects us. Nothing is misbehaving. The system is working exactly as designed, and that is precisely the problem for us.

blocks.html_en: First, we explain Android hardware attestation end to end. What problem it solves, where the trust actually comes from, and what the device really signs and sends. blocks.html_en: How does the server verify all this?

sentences.en: How does the server verify all this?
sentences.zh: 服务器如何验证这一切？

blocks.html_en: A correct verification is a chain of independent checks, done off device 5:

sentences.en: A correct verification is a chain of independent checks, done off device 5:
sentences.zh: 正确的验证是在设备 5 上完成的一系列独立检查：

blocks.html_en: • Parse the certificate chain and verify each signature up to the root.

sentences.en: Parse the certificate chain and verify each signature up to the root.
sentences.zh: 解析证书链并验证每个签名直至根。

blocks.html_en: • Confirm the root is a trusted Google Hardware Attestation Root from the published set.

sentences.en: Confirm the root is a trusted Google Hardware Attestation Root from the published set.
sentences.zh: 确认根是已发布的集中受信任的 Google 硬件证明根。

blocks.html_en: • Check the certificate validity dates.

sentences.en: Check the certificate validity dates.
sentences.zh: 检查证书的有效期。

blocks.html_en: • Extract the attestation extension and confirm attestationChallenge equals the nonce the server issued.

sentences.en: Extract the attestation extension and confirm attestationChallenge equals the nonce the server issued.
sentences.zh: 提取证明扩展并确认 attestationChallenge 等于服务器发出的随机数。

blocks.html_en: • Read securityLevel, the key properties and the root of trust from the extension, from the hardwareEnforced list, and apply the policy the service wants.

sentences.en: Read securityLevel, the key properties and the root of trust from the extension, from the hardwareEnforced list, and apply the policy the service wants.
sentences.zh: 从硬件强制列表中读取扩展的安全级别、关键属性和信任根，并应用服务所需的策略。

blocks.html_en: • Check that no certificate in the chain has been revoked.

sentences.en: Check that no certificate in the chain has been revoked.
sentences.zh: 检查链中没有证书被吊销。

blocks.html_en: The last step relies on a revocation list that Google publishes at a single URL, https://android.googleapis.com/attestation/status, as JSON 8. Only keys with a non-valid status appear, so it is not a full list of issued keys. An entry carries a status, REVOKED for a permanent removal or SUSPENDED for a temporary one, and a reason such as KEY_COMPROMISE, CA_COMPROMISE, SUPERSEDED or SOFTWARE_FLAW.

sentences.en: The last step relies on a revocation list that Google publishes at a single URL, https://android.googleapis.com/attestation/status, as JSON 8.
sentences.zh: 最后一步依赖于 Google 在单个 URL（https://android.googleapis.com/attestation/status）上以 JSON 8 形式发布的撤销列表。

sentences.en: Only keys with a non-valid status appear, so it is not a full list of issued keys.

sentences.zh: 条目带有状态：“REVOKED”（永久删除）或“SUSPENDED”（临时删除），以及诸如 KEY_COMPROMISE、CA_COMPROMISE、SUPERSEDED 或 SOFTWARE_FLAW 之类的原因。

blocks.html_en: If any step fails, the attestation is not trusted. Note that every one of these checks runs on the server. The device only produces the evidence.

sentences.en: If any step fails, the attestation is not trusted.
sentences.zh: 如果任何步骤失败，则证明不被信任。

sentences.en: Note that every one of these checks runs on the server.
sentences.zh: 请注意，这些检查中的每一项都在服务器上运行。

sentences.en: The device only produces the evidence.
sentences.zh: 该设备仅产生证据。

blocks.html_en: Where do attestation keys come from: factory keys and RKP

sentences.en: Where do attestation keys come from: factory keys and RKP
sentences.zh: 证明密钥从哪里来：工厂密钥和 RKP

blocks.html_en: The whole chain rests on the private key that signs the leaf. Two provisioning models exist, and the difference matters for the limits we discuss next.

sentences.en: The whole chain rests on the private key that signs the leaf.
sentences.zh: 整个链依赖于对叶子进行签名的私钥。

sentences.en: Two provisioning models exist, and the difference matters for the limits we discuss next.
sentences.zh: 存在两种配置模型，其差异对于我们接下来讨论的限制很重要。

blocks.html_en: The older model is factory provisioning, also called batch keys. An attestation key and its certificate are injected at manufacturing time and shared across a batch of devices. In that model the leaf issuer matches the subject of the batch attestation key. One private key covers many devices, which is efficient but fragile. If that key leaks, every device in the batch can be impersonated, and the only response is to revoke it through the status list 8.

sentences.en: The older model is factory provisioning, also called batch keys.
sentences.zh: 旧模型是工厂配置，也称为批量密钥。

sentences.en: An attestation key and its certificate are injected at manufacturing time and shared across a batch of devices.
sentences.zh: 证明密钥及其证书在制造时注入并在一批设备之间共享。

sentences.en: In that model the leaf issuer matches the subject of the batch attestation key.
sentences.zh: 在该模型中，叶颁发者与批量证明密钥的主题相匹配。

sentences.en: One private key covers many devices, which is efficient but fragile.
sentences.zh: 一张私钥覆盖多个设备，高效但脆弱。

sentences.en: If that key leaks, every device in the batch can be impersonated, and the only response is to revoke it through the status list 8.
sentences.zh: 如果该密钥泄露，该批次中的每个设备都可以被冒充，唯一的响应是通过状态列表撤销它 8。

blocks.html_en: The newer model is Remote Key Provisioning, RKP, part of AOSP since Android 12 9. Here the factory does not program long-lived signing keys onto the device. Instead the device proves the health of its own key generation to a Google backend, which issues short-lived certificates per device. Two properties follow directly:

sentences.en: The newer model is Remote Key Provisioning, RKP, part of AOSP since Android 12 9.
sentences.zh: 较新的模型是远程密钥配置（RKP），自 Android 12 9 起成为 AOSP 的一部分。

sentences.en: Here the factory does not program long-lived signing keys onto the device.
sentences.zh: 这里，工厂不会将长期签名密钥编程到设备上。

sentences.en: Two properties follow directly:
sentences.zh: 直接遵循两个属性：

blocks.html_en: • Revocation can target a single device rather than a whole batch.

sentences.en: Revocation can target a single device rather than a whole batch.
sentences.zh: 撤销可以针对单个设备而不是整个批次。

blocks.html_en: • Certificates are short-lived, so the validity period must be checked, which shortens the window a compromise stays useful.

sentences.en: Certificates are short-lived, so the validity period must be checked, which shortens the window a compromise stays useful.
sentences.zh: 证书的有效期是短暂的，因此必须检查其有效期，这会缩短妥协的有用时间。

blocks.html_en: Android 14 introduced RKP as an updatable module so the service can be improved without a full OS update 9. For devices that launch on Android 16, the system supports only RKP, and factory keys are phased out.

sentences.en: Android 14 introduced RKP as an updatable module so the service can be improved without a full OS update 9.

blocks.html_en: What attestation does not prove

sentences.en: What attestation does not prove
sentences.zh: 证明不能证明什么

blocks.html_en: Attestation is strong, but its guarantees are narrow and precise. Reading them precisely is what makes a bypass possible.

sentences.en: Attestation is strong, but its guarantees are narrow and precise.
sentences.zh: 证明是强有力的，但其保证是狭窄和精确的。

sentences.en: Reading them precisely is what makes a bypass possible.
sentences.zh: 准确地阅读它们才能使绕过成为可能。

blocks.html_en: First, every hardware guarantee is conditional on the secure hardware not being compromised. The SecurityLevel definitions say so in as many words. TrustedEnvironment is secure as long as the TEE is not compromised, StrongBox as long as StrongBox is not compromised. Attestation does not prove the TEE is intact, it assumes it. TEE and firmware key extraction is exactly the class of failure the revocation list exists to contain 8. It is not hypothetical. Researchers have pulled hardware-backed ECDSA keys out of Qualcomm's TrustZone through a microarchitectural side channel 18, and broken the key protection in Samsung's TrustZone Keymaster design 19.

sentences.en: First, every hardware guarantee is conditional on the secure hardware not being compromised.
sentences.zh: 首先，每项硬件保证都以安全硬件不受到损害为条件。

sentences.en: The SecurityLevel definitions say so in as many words.
sentences.zh: SecurityLevel 定义用尽可能多的语言表达了这一点。

sentences.en: TrustedEnvironment is secure as long as the TEE is not compromised, StrongBox as long as StrongBox is not compromised.
sentences.zh: 只要 TEE 不被破坏，TrustedEnvironment 就是安全的；只要 StrongBox 不被破坏，StrongBox 就是安全的。

sentences.en: Attestation does not prove the TEE is intact, it assumes it.
sentences.zh: 证明并不能证明 TEE 完好无损，而是假设它完好无损。

sentences.en: TEE and firmware key extraction is exactly the class of failure the revocation list exists to contain 8.
sentences.zh: TEE和固件密钥提取正是撤销列表中存在的包含8个的故障类别。

sentences.en: It is not hypothetical.
sentences.zh: 这不是假设。

sentences.en: Researchers have pulled hardware-backed ECDSA keys out of Qualcomm's TrustZone through a microarchitectural side channel 18, and broken the key protection in Samsung's TrustZone Keymaster design 19.
sentences.zh: 研究人员通过微架构侧通道从高通的 TrustZone 中提取了硬件支持的 ECDSA 密钥 18，并突破了三星 TrustZone Keymaster 设计中的密钥保护 19。

blocks.html_en: Second, a leaked attestation private key breaks the model for as long as it takes to detect and revoke it. Batch keys make this worse because one leak covers many devices. This is a known and documented failure mode, and it is the reason RKP and revocation exist at all 89.

sentences.en: Second, a leaked attestation private key breaks the model for as long as it takes to detect and revoke it.
sentences.zh: 其次，泄露的证明私钥会在检测和撤销模型所需的时间内破坏模型。

sentences.en: Batch keys make this worse because one leak covers many devices.
sentences.zh: 批量密钥使情况变得更糟，因为一次泄漏涵盖了许多设备。

sentences.en: This is a known and documented failure mode, and it is the reason RKP and revocation exist at all 89.
sentences.zh: 这是一种已知且有记录的故障模式，也是 RKP 和撤销存在的原因 89。

blocks.html_en: Third, and this is the point we build on, attestation binds a key to a healthy device, but it does not bind that key to this device or to the process that is asking. The certificate proves that some device with a locked bootloader and a verified boot state generated a key and signed a challenge. It says nothing about where that device is, or whether the app talking to the backend is running on the same hardware that produced the evidence. Nothing in the KeyDescription ties the attestation to a network location, a session, or a running process context.

sentences.en: Third, and this is the point we build on, attestation binds a key to a healthy device, but it does not bind that key to this device or to the process that is asking.
sentences.zh: 第三，这是我们构建的基础，证明将密钥绑定到健康的设备，但它不会将该密钥绑定到该设备或请求的进程。

sentences.en: The certificate proves that some device with a locked bootloader and a verified boot state generated a key and signed a challenge.
sentences.zh: 该证书证明某些具有锁定引导加载程序和经过验证的引导状态的设备生成了密钥并签署了质询。

sentences.en: It says nothing about where that device is, or whether the app talking to the backend is running on the same hardware that produced the evidence.
sentences.zh: 它没有说明该设备在哪里，也没有说明与后端通信的应用程序是否在产生证据的同一硬件上运行。

sentences.en: Nothing in the KeyDescription ties the attestation to a network location, a session, or a running process context.
sentences.zh: KeyDescription 中没有任何内容将证明与网络位置、会话或正在运行的进程上下文联系起来。

blocks.html_en: That gap is the whole opportunity for the analyst. If our mission device cannot produce a Verified attestation, but a healthy device can, and the backend cannot tell which physical device the evidence came from, then the evidence can be generated in one place and presented from another. This is the idea behind the relay technique that the security community calls Remote Key Attestation, documented from the defensive side by Guardsquare 1. The next section takes the analyst view of the same idea and builds a reproducible setup around it.

sentences.en: This is the idea behind the relay technique that the security community calls Remote Key Attestation, documented from the defensive side by Guardsquare 1.
sentences.zh: 这就是安全社区称之为远程密钥证明的中继技术背后的想法，由 Guardsquare 1 从防御方进行了记录。

sentences.en: The next section takes the analyst view of the same idea and builds a reproducible setup around it.
sentences.zh: 下一节将从分析师的角度看待同一想法，并围绕它构建一个可重复的设置。

blocks.html_en: That is the mechanism end to end. Attestation is a signed statement, produced in secure hardware, describing a key and the boot state of the device that made it, verified off device against a Google root and a revocation list. Its strength is real and its scope is exact. In the next part we stay inside that scope and use instrumentation to move a valid statement from a legitimate device to the one under analysis.

sentences.zh: 证明是一份签名声明，在安全硬件中生成，描述密钥和制造该密钥的设备的启动状态，并根据 Google 根和吊销列表在设备上进行验证。

blocks.html_en: In the previous section we followed a hardware attestation from key generation to backend verdict. Now we are on a rooted mission phone, bootloader unlocked, and the app we want to analyze uses hardware attestation as a gate. Before any interesting feature runs, the app asks the Android Keystore for an attested key, sends the certificate chain to its backend, and waits for a green light. On our device that light stays red.

blocks.html_en: The reason is exactly what makes attestation useful. As we saw, the RootOfTrust structure lives in the hardwareEnforced authorization list, produced by the secure environment and not by the platform. Our unlocked bootloader is written there in plain sight: deviceLocked is false and verifiedBootState is not Verified. The chain is otherwise perfectly genuine. sentences.zh: 它链接到 Google 根，签名有效，挑战匹配。

sentences.en: It just tells the truth about our device, and the truth gets us rejected.
sentences.zh: 它只是讲述了有关我们设备的真相，而真相却让我们拒绝了。

blocks.html_en: The demo client shows exactly this. The backend answers HTTP 400: deviceLocked false, verifiedBootState Unverified, StrongBox-backed chain and all.

blocks.html_en: So we need the backend to receive a chain that reports a healthy device, without giving up the root access we need to do our job. Let us look at our options.

blocks.html_en: A genuinely clean phone passing attestation is not a bypass. It is attestation doing its job. The bypass begins when we take that clean phone's attestation and use it to answer for our rooted phone.

sentences.en: A genuinely clean phone passing attestation is not a bypass.
sentences.zh: 真正干净的手机通过认证并不是绕过。

sentences.en: It is attestation doing its job.
sentences.zh: 这是证明在履行其职责。

sentences.en: The bypass begins when we take that clean phone's attestation and use it to answer for our rooted phone.
sentences.zh: 当我们获取干净手机的认证并使用它来应答我们已root的手机时，绕过就开始了。

blocks.html_en: The plan is a relay. The target app, running on our rooted phone, is about to ask its local Keystore for an attested key. We intercept that request. We forward the backend's challenge to a clean phone, which runs its own attestation and hands us back a real certificate chain, signed by real secure hardware, and carrying our challenge. We return that chain to the app as if the local Keystore had produced it. The app forwards it to the backend. The backend sees a genuine chain, a matching challenge, and a locked, verified device, and it validates.

sentences.en: The plan is a relay.
sentences.zh: 该计划是一个接力。

sentences.en: The target app, running on our rooted phone, is about to ask its local Keystore for an attested key.
sentences.zh: 在我们已root的手机上运行的目标应用程序将向其本地密钥库询问经过验证的密钥。

sentences.en: We intercept that request.
sentences.zh: 我们拦截该请求。

sentences.en: We forward the backend's challenge to a clean phone, which runs its own attestation and hands us back a real certificate chain, signed by real secure hardware, and carrying our challenge.
sentences.zh: 我们将后端的挑战转发给一个干净的手机，它运行自己的证明并向我们返回一个真实的证书链，由真正的安全硬件签名，并承载我们的挑战。

sentences.en: We return that chain to the app as if the local Keystore had produced it.
sentences.zh: 我们将该链返回给应用程序，就好像本地密钥库已生成它一样。

sentences.en: The app forwards it to the backend.
sentences.zh: 应用程序将其转发到后端。

sentences.en: The backend sees a genuine chain, a matching challenge, and a locked, verified device, and it validates.
sentences.zh: 后端看到一条真正的链、一个匹配的挑战和一个锁定的、经过验证的设备，然后进行验证。

blocks.html_en: On a clean phone this method returns a chain that reports a locked device. On our rooted phone it returns a chain that reports an unlocked one. Same code, same key, different verdict. The method is the seam. Everything device-specific is behind it, and its signature is small.

sentences.en: Everything device-specific is behind it, and its signature is small.

sentences.en: We can forward it as is, no reshaping.

sentences.zh: 到达后端的链是由锁定的、经过验证的手机上的真正安全硬件生成的。

sentences.zh: 挑战绑定成立，因为链中的 attestationChallenge 是我们未更改地转发的随机数。

sentences.zh: 设备策略是我们 root 后的手机可能会死机的地方，也是中继拯救我们的地方。

sentences.en: The backend reads the RootOfTrust only from the hardwareEnforced list, exactly as it should, since the software list can be written by a compromised platform.
sentences.zh: 后端仅从 hardwareEnforced 列表中读取 RootOfTrust，这与它应该的完全一样，因为软件列表可以由受损平台写入。

sentences.zh: KeyMint 从证明版本 300 开始将其重命名为 hardwareEnforced，并且当前的 AOSP 架构始终使用该名称。

blocks.html_en: What can the backend actually see? This is what makes the relay work, and what a mitigation has to change.

sentences.en: What can the backend actually see?
sentences.zh: 后台到底能看到什么？

sentences.en: This is what makes the relay work, and what a mitigation has to change.
sentences.zh: 这就是中继工作的原因，也是缓解措施必须改变的地方。

blocks.html_en: The certificate chain proves that a key lives in genuine secure hardware on a locked, verified device, and that this hardware saw our challenge. It does not prove which phone is talking to the backend right now. There is no field in the KeyDescription that binds the attestation to the transport, the session, or the device presenting it. The nonce is the only freshness signal, and we forwarded it faithfully. From the backend's chair, a relayed chain and a local chain are the same bytes.

sentences.en: From the backend's chair, a relayed chain and a local chain are the same bytes.

blocks.html_en: Where the simple relay stops

sentences.en: Where the simple relay stops
sentences.zh: 简单继电器停止的地方

blocks.html_en: Our relay leans on two things the backend fails to do, and naming them points straight at the mitigations.

sentences.en: Our relay leans on two things the backend fails to do, and naming them points straight at the mitigations.
sentences.zh: 我们的中继依赖于后端无法完成的两件事，并且将它们命名直接指向缓解措施。

blocks.html_en: The first is decisive. The backend never checks which app the chain was issued to. Our chain is produced on the clean phone by a different app than the target, and the attestation says so. The app identity is written into the certificate under attestationApplicationId. Our backend simply never reads it. The moment it does, and compares that field to the app it expects, the chain we built is rejected. That single check is where our relay stops, and it is the cheapest of all.

sentences.en: The first is decisive.
sentences.zh: 第一个是决定性的。

sentences.en: The backend never checks which app the chain was issued to.
sentences.zh: 后端从不检查链被发布到哪个应用程序。

sentences.en: Our chain is produced on the clean phone by a different app than the target, and the attestation says so.
sentences.zh: 我们的链是在干净的手机上由与目标不同的应用程序生成的，证明也是如此。

sentences.en: The app identity is written into the certificate under attestationApplicationId.
sentences.zh: 应用程序身份写入到 attestationApplicationId 下的证书中。

sentences.en: Our backend simply never reads it.
sentences.zh: 我们的后端根本不会读取它。

sentences.en: The moment it does, and compares that field to the app it expects, the chain we built is rejected.
sentences.zh: 一旦它这样做，并将该字段与它期望的应用程序进行比较，我们构建的链就会被拒绝。

sentences.en: That single check is where our relay stops, and it is the cheapest of all.
sentences.zh: 那次检查就是我们的中继停止的地方，而且它是所有检查中最便宜的。

blocks.html_en: The second is deeper. The relay assumes attestation is a one-shot gate. The app attests once, at launch or during login, the backend validates the chain and the nonce, grants access, and moves on. That assumption holds surprisingly often, and when it does the relay is enough. It breaks the moment the backend asks the client to prove, later in the same session, that it holds the attested private key. The attested key lives on the clean phone, not on our rooted one. We relayed a chain, not a key. If the backend sends a fresh value to sign with that key and checks the signature, our test device cannot answer on its own. We would have to relay signing operations too, keeping the clean phone in the loop for every signed message. The one-shot courier becomes a live proxy, heavier and far more fragile, but not stopped.

sentences.zh: 令人惊讶的是，这种假设经常成立，当它成立时，中继就足够了。

sentences.en: It breaks the moment the backend asks the client to prove, later in the same session, that it holds the attested private key.
sentences.zh: 当后端要求客户端稍后在同一会话中证明它拥有经过验证的私钥时，它就会中断。

sentences.en: The attested key lives on the clean phone, not on our rooted one.
sentences.zh: 经过验证的密钥存在于干净的手机上，而不是我们root过的手机上。

sentences.en: We relayed a chain, not a key.
sentences.zh: 我们传递的是一条链，而不是一把钥匙。

sentences.en: If the backend sends a fresh value to sign with that key and checks the signature, our test device cannot answer on its own.
sentences.zh: 如果后端发送一个新值以使用该密钥进行签名并检查签名，我们的测试设备将无法自行应答。

sentences.en: The one-shot courier becomes a live proxy, heavier and far more fragile, but not stopped.

blocks.html_en: Mitigation

sentences.en: Mitigation
sentences.zh: 减轻

blocks.html_en: We now switch chairs and look at the relay from the backend side. The question is simple. What check would have stopped our own bypass? We take the mitigations cheapest first, and we keep each one honest. For every proposal we say what it forces the attacker to do, and what it does not solve.

sentences.zh: 现在我们换椅子并从后端查看继电器。

sentences.en: The question is simple.
sentences.zh: 问题很简单。

sentences.en: What check would have stopped our own bypass?
sentences.zh: 什么检查可以阻止我们自己的绕过？

sentences.en: We take the mitigations cheapest first, and we keep each one honest.
sentences.zh: 我们首先采取最便宜的缓解措施，并且我们让每一个措施都保持诚实。

sentences.en: For every proposal we say what it forces the attacker to do, and what it does not solve.

blocks.html_en: One caveat up front. The first mitigation has been tested against our own relay. Its code, however, does not ship with this article. The companion backend leaves it out on purpose, so the relay has a gate to walk through. We ran the check separately and confirmed it rejects the relayed chain. The second is a design proposal. We reason about it and point at the standards it rests on, but we did not build it and we did not test it. We flag this again in each section and in the synthesis table, so the reader can tell a tested control from a blueprint.

blocks.html_en: It is worth being clear about what the relay exploits. It is not a weakness in the attestation mechanism. The chain we relayed is genuine, the signatures are valid, the hardware told the truth. What let us through is a backend that validated the chain without checking who it was issued to. The relay worked because of two gaps.

sentences.en: It is worth being clear about what the relay exploits.

blocks.html_en: There is a catch, and it is the reason this check is placed first but not alone. attestationApplicationId lives in the softwareEnforced list, populated by the Android platform, not by the secure hardware. A software-enforced value can be trusted only as long as the device that produced it runs an operating system that complies with the Android Platform Security Model, that is, its bootloader is locked and its verifiedBootState is Verified 2. On a directly rooted phone, with no relay, a compromised platform could write anything here.

sentences.en: There is a catch, and it is the reason this check is placed first but not alone.

blocks.html_en: Once that check passes, the chain was generated on a device whose OS satisfies the security model. On such a device the softwareEnforced values are trustworthy. blocks.html_en: Concretely, the backend adds one comparison after parsing the extension.

blocks.html_en: In our relay the chain is produced by the clean oracle, which runs com.quarkslab.attestation.server. Its honest platform writes that package and its own signing digest into the field. The comparison fails and the chain is rejected. The analyst cannot repackage around it either. A clean verified-boot OS will report the true identity, and the signing certificate digest cannot be matched without the target's private signing key. We added this check in a separate test and it rejected the relayed chain. This single comparison kills the cross-app relay we built, even though the shipped backend leaves it out on purpose.

sentences.en: In our relay the chain is produced by the clean oracle, which runs com.quarkslab.attestation.server.
sentences.zh: 在我们的中继中，链是由运行 com.quarkslab.attestation.server 的干净预言机生成的。

sentences.en: Its honest platform writes that package and its own signing digest into the field.
sentences.zh: 它的诚实平台将该包和它自己的签名摘要写入该字段。

sentences.en: The comparison fails and the chain is rejected.

sentences.en: The analyst cannot repackage around it either.

sentences.en: A clean verified-boot OS will report the true identity, and the signing certificate digest cannot be matched without the target's private signing key.
sentences.zh: 干净的验证启动操作系统将报告真实身份，并且如果没有目标的私有签名密钥，则无法匹配签名证书摘要。

sentences.en: We added this check in a separate test and it rejected the relayed chain.

blocks.html_en: The app check closes the relay we demonstrated. Could a determined analyst still get past it? Only by producing the attestation from a clean instance of the very same app, so that the package and the signing digest match. That is harder than it sounds. It means driving the real target app, on a clean and verified device, to attest a challenge the analyst chooses and to hand back the raw chain. A clean verified device is exactly the kind you cannot instrument. There is no easy way to inject the nonce or to export the chain. Rooting that device to instrument it would break its verified boot state and fail the attestation. Short of a keybox or a TEE bug, which is the hardware path we set aside, the same-app relay stays out of reach.

blocks.html_en: Suppose the analyst gets there anyway. The deeper problem is that the backend inspects a certificate and never asks the client to use the key it certifies. blocks.html_en: We set out to do two things. Understand what Android hardware attestation proves, and get past it when it blocks an analysis. Both are done, and they point at the same lesson.

sentences.en: We set out to do two things.
sentences.zh: 我们着手做两件事。

sentences.en: Understand what Android hardware attestation proves, and get past it when it blocks an analysis.
sentences.zh: 了解 Android 硬件认证证明了什么，并在它阻止分析时绕过它。

blocks.html_en: The mechanism itself is sound. A key generated in a TEE or a StrongBox is signed by a key the device cannot choose or forge, the chain climbs to a Google root, and the RootOfTrust reports the boot state without asking the platform for permission. On our rooted phone that machinery worked exactly as designed. It told the truth, and the truth locked us out. There was no cryptography to break, and we did not try.

sentences.en: The mechanism itself is sound.
sentences.zh: 机制本身是健全的。

sentences.en: A key generated in a TEE or a StrongBox is signed by a key the device cannot choose or forge, the chain climbs to a Google root, and the RootOfTrust reports the boot state without asking the platform for permission.
sentences.zh: TEE 或 StrongBox 中生成的密钥由设备无法选择或伪造的密钥进行签名，该链会爬升到 Google 根，并且 RootOfTrust 会报告启动状态，而无需请求平台许可。

sentences.en: On our rooted phone that machinery worked exactly as designed.
sentences.zh: 在我们root过的手机上，机器完全按照设计工作。

sentences.en: It told the truth, and the truth locked us out.
sentences.zh: 它说的是实话，而真相却把我们拒之门外。

sentences.en: There was no cryptography to break, and we did not try.
sentences.zh: 没有密码学可以破解，我们也没有尝试。

blocks.html_en: What we broke was an assumption. The backend treated a signed certificate as proof that the phone in front of it was healthy. It is not. It is proof that some phone, somewhere, has healthy hardware and once saw our challenge. We supplied that phone. A clean device answered the attestation, its genuine chain traveled back through a Frida hook, and the backend validated a device it had never met. We changed neither the key nor the boot state. We changed who got asked.

sentences.en: What we broke was an assumption.
sentences.zh: 我们打破的是一个假设。

sentences.en: The backend treated a signed certificate as proof that the phone in front of it was healthy.
sentences.zh: 后端将签名的证书视为前面的手机运行状况良好的证据。

sentences.en: It is not.
sentences.zh: 它不是。

sentences.en: It is proof that some phone, somewhere, has healthy hardware and once saw our challenge.
sentences.zh: 这证明某些手机在某个地方拥有健康的硬件并且曾经遇到过我们的挑战。

sentences.en: We supplied that phone.
sentences.zh: 我们提供了那部电话。

sentences.en: A clean device answered the attestation, its genuine chain traveled back through a Frida hook, and the backend validated a device it had never met.
sentences.zh: 一个干净的设备响应了认证，它的真实链通过 Frida 钩子传回，后端验证了一个它从未遇到过的设备。

sentences.en: We changed neither the key nor the boot state.
sentences.zh: 我们既没有更改密钥，也没有更改启动状态。

blocks.html_en: That is the moral, and it is not specific to attestation. A hardware guarantee is only as strong as the protocol that consumes it. Attestation certifies a key, on a device, at a moment in time. It says nothing about which app requested it or whether that key is ever used again. A backend that reads only "valid chain, healthy device" and opens the gate has turned a hardware guarantee into a formality. Closing the gap does not call for better silicon. It calls for the backend to bind the attestation to the app that asked. That check is cheap and unglamorous, which is probably why it is so often skipped.

content_html_zh:
硬件密钥证明可让 Android 应用程序向其后端证明密钥存在于锁定、经过验证的设备上的安全硬件中。 这也是阻止安全分析师在 root 手机上工作的墙。 本文从分析师的角度打开了该机制，从证书链和证明扩展一直到信任根，然后展示了一种从不触及安全硬件的简单旁路。 我们将证明转发到干净的设备，并使用 Frida hook 将真正的链拼接回目标应用程序。 配套存储库提供了验证后端、演示应用程序和仪器，因此可以运行和检查整个设置，而不是盲目相信。

介绍

越来越多的 Android 应用程序在让我们进入之前想知道一件事：这个设备值得信赖吗？ 银行应用程序、支付钱包、身份 SDK 和越来越多的其他应用程序现在要求操作系统证明手机是运行未被篡改的启动链的真实设备。 如果答案是否定的，应用程序就会降级，拒绝某项功能，或者直接关门。

对于证券分析师来说，这是一堵熟悉的墙。 我们的任务电话通常是 root 的。 这不是偶然，而是工作。 Root 允许我们在应用程序运行时挂钩、跟踪、转储和读取应用程序。 当目标应用程序依赖于硬件认证时，相同的 root 状态就成为我们被锁定的原因。 该应用程序要求硬件提供有关该设备的签名声明，硬件诚实地报告信任根已损坏，而后端拒绝了我们。 没有什么行为不端。 该系统完全按照设计运行，这正是我们面临的问题。

本文按顺序有两个目标。

首先，我们端到端地解释 Android 硬件认证。 它解决什么问题，信任实际上来自哪里，以及设备真正签名和发送的内容。 我们打开证书链，浏览证明扩展，并查看后端检查的字段以做出决定。

其次，我们提出了一个基于仪器的简单旁路。 我们远离难题。 我们不会攻击安全硬件，我们不会提取密钥，我们也不需要泄露的密钥箱。 相反，我们坐在分析师已经坐的地方，在运行的流程中，并重定向证明请求。 干净、未经修改的手机会用自己健康的硬件来应答它，并将其签名的声明转发回来，以解锁对 root 设备的分析。 诀窍不是破坏密码。 诀窍在于决定谁被问到。

整个设置是可重复的。 配套存储库提供了验证后端、演示应用程序以及用于中继的 Frida 仪器。

https://github.com/quarkslab/android-hardware-attestation-demo

关于范围的注释。 多年来，Android 上的认证已经发生了很大变化，而且仍然在变化。 我们的目标是现代设备，即 Android 13 及更高版本，并且我们会在每个版本存在差异的地方指出其行为。 StrongBox出现在它改变画面的地方，但它不是我们的主轴。

里程碑一览 29：

安卓 安全组件 里程碑
7.0 钥匙大师2 密钥认证介绍
8.0 钥匙大师3 已添加身份证明
12 KeyMint，由 Keymaster 更名而来 RKP登陆AOSP
14 密钥薄荷 RKP 成为可更新模块
16 密钥薄荷 仅限 RKP，工厂密钥已逐步淘汰

这里的 RKP 是远程密钥配置，即从工厂注入的证明密钥转变为由 Google 后端为每个设备颁发的短期密钥。 我们将在配置部分详细讨论它。

设置框架后，我们从应用程序启动的地方开始，要求硬件为手机提供担保。

我们的出发点很简单。 我们在取得 root 权限的设备上运行应用程序，并在某个时刻分析停止。 请求失败、功能拒绝加载、登录永远无法完成。 在应用程序的某个地方有一个检查，可以确定我们的设备不值得信任，而且它是正确的。 在我们击败该检查之前，我们需要了解它实际测量的内容。 这部分回答了这个问题。 在本文结束时，读者应该知道硬件证明证明了什么，证明是如何构建和携带的，以及它的保证在哪里停止。

我们保持分析师的关注：我们希望了解服务在查看我们的设备时看到了什么，以便稍后我们可以决定更改哪些内容以及我们需要付出什么代价。

证明实际上证明了什么？

Android Keystore 允许应用程序创建和使用加密密钥，而无需接触原始密钥材料。 在具有硬件支持的设备上，密钥位于安全硬件内，并且平台仅向其发送命令。 问题在于信任。 在证明之前，应用程序或远程服务器没有可靠的方法来了解给定的密钥库密钥是否真正受硬件支持，或者只是一个冒充硬件支持的软件密钥。 Keystore 守护进程加载了存在的任何 Keymaster HAL，即与安全组件对话的供应商硬件抽象层，并相信 HAL 所声称的硬件支持 2。

引入密钥证明来缩小这一差距。 它是在 Android 7.0 的 Keymaster 2 中添加的，ID 认证是在 Android 8.0 的 Keymaster 3 中添加的。 其目标是让远程方可靠地确定有关密钥对的三件事：

  • 私钥实际上存在于硬件支持的存储中。
  • 密钥具有已知的属性，例如其算法、大小和用途。
  • 已知的约束控制密钥的使用方式。
Keymaster 和 KeyMint。 Keymaster 是保护 Keystore 密钥的安全组件的历史名称。 它在 Android 12 中更名为 KeyMint。 我们仅在谈论旧设备时才使用 KeyMint 来处理当前行为，而使用 Keymaster。

证明的输出是一个 X.509 证书，它描述了经过证明的密钥以及密钥生成时设备的状态，由设备未选择且无法伪造的密钥签名。 这部分的其余部分是关于该证书的内容以及承载该证书的链。

钥匙在哪里：TEE 和 StrongBox

仅当我们知道经证明的密钥存储在哪里以及该位置抵抗攻击的能力如何时，证明才有意义。 证书通过 SecurityLevel 值 2 明确说明这一点：

SecurityLevel ::= ENUMERATED {
    Software                     (0),
    TrustedEnvironment           (1),
    StrongBox                    (2),
}
ASN.1 和 DER。 本文中的结构是用 ASN.1 编写的，这是一种用于描述类型化数据（例如序列、枚举和八位字节字符串）的表示法。 DER 是该数据实际位于证书内的字节编码。 当我们说某个字段是 DER 编码时，我们的意思是它被打包成字节，解析器一次遍历一个字段。

这三个级别描述了密钥及其证明对攻击的弹性：

  • 软件。 仅当 Android 系统本身完好无损时才安全，这意味着引导加载程序被锁定并且验证启动报告已验证状态。 这里没有硬件保证。
  • 值得信赖的环境。 由设备可信执行环境强制执行。 只要 TEE 不受到损害即可确保安全。 兼容性定义文档第 9.11 3 节规定了隔离要求。 TEE 对远程攻击有很强的抵抗力，对直接硬件攻击有一定的抵抗力 2。
  • 保险柜。 由专用安全元件强制执行，类似于硬件安全模块，具有自己的 CPU 和存储 4。 要求见 CDD 第 9.11.2 3 节。 StrongBox 对远程攻击和直接硬件攻击（例如物理篡改和侧信道分析 2）具有很强的抵抗力。
TEE 和保险箱。 TEE 是一个安全世界，在同一应用程序处理器上与 Android 一起运行，由硬件（例如 ARM TrustZone）隔离。 StrongBox 是一个物理上独立的芯片。 对我们来说，实际的区别在于攻击的成本。 TEE 与主操作系统共享芯片，而 StrongBox 则不然。

只要求软件级别的检查很弱，并且经常在根本不触及硬件的情况下失败。 需要 TrustedEnvironment 或 StrongBox 的检查是一个有趣的案例，也是本文讨论的案例。

认证证书链

当应用程序生成具有证明质询的密钥时，KeyMint 返回的不是单个证书，而是一个链。 应用程序使用 KeyStore.getCertificateChain() 读取它，并以正确的设计将其转发到它信任的服务器，而不是在本地验证它 5. 原因很直接。 如果设备操作系统受到损害，可以进行设备上检查以信任任何内容。

链条已订购。 条目 0 是叶子，即证明证书本身。 它对经证明的公钥进行证明并携带证明扩展。 接下来的每个证书都会对前一个证书进行签名，直至根证书。 在随 Google Play 提供并在 Android 7.0 或更高版本上启动的设备上，该根是 Google 硬件证明根，并且有效根集作为 JSON 数组发布，以便后端可以将它们固定为 5。

叶子是标准 X.509 v3 证书，但它的几个字段已修复并由兼容性测试套件 (CTS) 2 进行精确检查：

Field Value
序列号 INTEGER 1，每个认证证书上都相同
主题 CN =“Android 密钥库密钥”，每个证书上都相同
有效性 派生自关键 ACTIVE_DATETIME 和 USAGE_EXPIRE_DATETIME 标签
扩展 包含证明扩展，OID 1.3.6.1.4.1.11129.2.1.17

固定的序列号和主题是一个常见的陷阱。 它们不是标识符。 每个设备上的每个证明叶都带有相同的两个值。 设备的身份和状态不在这些字段中。 它们位于证明扩展内。

证明扩展内部：KeyDescription

证明扩展具有 OID 1.3.6.1.4.1.11129.2.1.17，这是一个对象标识符，其 1.3.6.1.4.1.11129 弧保留给 Google。 它的内容是一个 DER 编码的 KeyDescription 结构，其中包含验证者关心的所有内容。 以下是 KeyMint 5 2 附带的当前架构，版本 500：

KeyDescription ::= SEQUENCE {
    attestationVersion           INTEGER, # Value 500
    attestationSecurityLevel     SecurityLevel,
    keyMintVersion               INTEGER, # Value 500
    keyMintSecurityLevel         SecurityLevel,
    attestationChallenge         OCTET_STRING,
    uniqueId                     OCTET_STRING,
    softwareEnforced             AuthorizationList,
    hardwareEnforced             AuthorizationList,
}

有两个领域值得立即关注。

证明挑战是随机数。 它返回调用者在密钥生成时通过的确切挑战。 后端生成一个新的随机质询，将其发送到客户端，然后检查此处是否出现相同的字节。 这就是使证明变得新鲜并将其绑定到一个验证交换而不是重放捕获的原因。

attestationVersion 告诉解析器需要哪种模式，以及哪一代 KeyMint 或 Keymaster 生成了证书 2：

Value KeyMint 或 Keymaster 版本
1 钥匙大师2.0
2 钥匙大师3.0
3 钥匙大师4.0
4 钥匙大师 4.1
100 密钥薄荷1.0
200 密钥薄荷2.0
300 密钥薄荷3.0
400 密钥薄荷4.0
500 密钥薄荷5.0

两个 AuthorizationList 字段是描述的核心，它们之间的区别是硬件证明 2 的全部要点：

  • softwareEnforced 拥有 Android 平台代码强制执行的属性。 仅当操作系统符合 Android 平台安全模型（即引导加载程序锁定且已验证引导处于已验证状态）时，它们才值得信任。
  • hardwareEnforced 拥有 TEE 或 StrongBox 强制执行的属性。 它们收集在安全硬件内，不受平台控制。

后端真正依赖的任何内容都应该从 hardwareEnforced 读取，因为根平台可以自由地塑造 softwareEnforced。 当我们稍后寻找要攻击的内容时，我们会查看后端信任的内容，而编写良好的后端会信任硬件执行的方面。

信任之根

hardwareEnforced 中最重要的一个条目是信任根，位于标签 [704] 2 下：

RootOfTrust ::= SEQUENCE {
    verifiedBootKey            OCTET_STRING,
    deviceLocked               BOOLEAN,
    verifiedBootState          VerifiedBootState,
    verifiedBootHash           OCTET_STRING,
}

VerifiedBootState ::= ENUMERATED {
    Verified                   (0),
    SelfSigned                 (1),
    Unverified                 (2),
    Failed                     (3),
}

这四个字段由安全硬件填充，这些安全硬件是在 Android 运行之前在验证启动期间进行的测量。 它们描述的是引导链，而不是正在运行的系统。

  • verifiedBootKey 是用于验证启动映像的密钥的哈希值。
  • 当引导加载程序被锁定时，deviceLocked 为 true。
  • verifiedBootHash 是已验证启动状态的摘要。
  • verifiedBootState 是应用程序真正需要的摘要。

四个 VerifiedBootState 值映射到引导加载程序可以设置的四个 Verified Boot 设备状态 67：

验证启动状态 已验证的靴子颜色 意义
已验证 Green 设备锁定、来自硬件根的完整信任链、库存操作系统
自签名 黄色的 设备已锁定，但根据用户提供的信任根进行启动验证
未验证 橙子 设备已解锁，未强制执行启动验证
失败的 Red 验证失败，未找到有效的操作系统

这是任务设备上阻挡我们的区域。 获得 root 权限的手机几乎总是报告“未验证”，因为 root 通常需要解锁引导加载程序。 要求验证并从硬件强制信任根读取它的后端将拒绝该设备，并且同一设备上的任何软件修补都不会更改这四个字节，因为它们来自 Android 下面。

已验证启动。 验证启动在运行之前会根据密钥检查启动的每个阶段，从引导加载程序到系统映像。 结果被冻结到 KeyMint 随后签署的信任根中。 这就是为什么事后无法从用户空间编辑状态的原因。 它是在用户空间存在之前测量的。

服务器如何验证这一切？

正确的验证是在设备 5 上完成的一系列独立检查：

  1. 解析证书链并验证每个签名直至根。
  2. 确认根是已发布的集中受信任的 Google 硬件证明根。
  3. 检查证书的有效期。
  4. 提取证明扩展并确认 attestationChallenge 等于服务器发出的随机数。
  5. 从硬件强制列表中读取扩展的安全级别、关键属性和信任根，并应用服务所需的策略。
  6. 检查链中没有证书被吊销。

最后一步依赖于 Google 在单个 URL（https://android.googleapis.com/attestation/status）上以 JSON 8 形式发布的撤销列表。 仅显示处于无效状态的密钥，因此它不是已颁发密钥的完整列表。 条目带有状态：“REVOKED”（永久删除）或“SUSPENDED”（临时删除），以及诸如 KEY_COMPROMISE、CA_COMPROMISE、SUPERSEDED 或 SOFTWARE_FLAW 之类的原因。

如果任何步骤失败，则证明不被信任。 请注意，这些检查中的每一项都在服务器上运行。 该设备仅产生证据。

证明密钥从哪里来：工厂密钥和 RKP

整个链依赖于对叶子进行签名的私钥。 存在两种配置模型，其差异对于我们接下来讨论的限制很重要。

旧模型是工厂配置，也称为批量密钥。 证明密钥及其证书在制造时注入并在一批设备之间共享。 在该模型中，叶颁发者与批量证明密钥的主题相匹配。 一张私钥覆盖多个设备，高效但脆弱。 如果该密钥泄露，该批次中的每个设备都可以被冒充，唯一的响应是通过状态列表撤销它 8。

较新的模型是远程密钥配置（RKP），自 Android 12 9 起成为 AOSP 的一部分。 这里，工厂不会将长期签名密钥编程到设备上。 相反，该设备向 Google 后端证明其自身密钥生成的运行状况，该后端为每个设备颁发短期证书。 直接遵循两个属性：

  • 撤销可以针对单个设备而不是整个批次。
  • 证书的有效期是短暂的，因此必须检查其有效期，这会缩短妥协的有用时间。

Android 14 引入了 RKP 作为可更新模块，因此无需完整操作系统更新 9 即可改进服务。 对于在 Android 16 上启动的设备，系统仅支持 RKP，并且工厂密钥将被逐步淘汰。

工厂钥匙和 RKP。 工厂钥匙就像一张由一千名员工共享的主徽章。 RKP 就像为每位员工颁发了一个很快就会过期的个人徽章。 如果一枚徽章泄露，您将取消一枚徽章，而不是取消大师徽章。

证明不能证明什么

证明是强有力的，但其保证是狭窄和精确的。 准确地阅读它们才能使绕过成为可能。

首先，每项硬件保证都以安全硬件不受到损害为条件。 SecurityLevel 定义用尽可能多的语言表达了这一点。 只要 TEE 不被破坏，TrustedEnvironment 就是安全的；只要 StrongBox 不被破坏，StrongBox 就是安全的。 证明并不能证明 TEE 完好无损，而是假设它完好无损。 TEE和固件密钥提取正是撤销列表中存在的包含8个的故障类别。 这不是假设。 研究人员通过微架构侧通道从高通的 TrustZone 中提取了硬件支持的 ECDSA 密钥 18，并突破了三星 TrustZone Keymaster 设计中的密钥保护 19。

其次，泄露的证明私钥会在检测和撤销模型所需的时间内破坏模型。 批量密钥使情况变得更糟，因为一次泄漏涵盖了许多设备。 这是一种已知且有记录的故障模式，也是 RKP 和撤销存在的原因 89。

第三，这是我们构建的基础，证明将密钥绑定到健康的设备，但它不会将该密钥绑定到该设备或请求的进程。 该证书证明某些具有锁定引导加载程序和经过验证的引导状态的设备生成了密钥并签署了质询。 它没有说明该设备在哪里，也没有说明与后端通信的应用程序是否在产生证据的同一硬件上运行。 KeyDescription 中没有任何内容将证明与网络位置、会话或正在运行的进程上下文联系起来。

这个差距就是分析师的全部机会。 如果我们的任务设备无法生成已验证的证明，但健康的设备可以，并且后端无法判断证据来自哪个物理设备，则可以在一个地方生成证据并从另一个地方呈现。 这就是安全社区称之为远程密钥证明的中继技术背后的想法，由 Guardsquare 1 从防御方进行了记录。 下一节将从分析师的角度看待同一想法，并围绕它构建一个可重复的设置。

这就是端到端的机制。 证明是一份签名声明，在安全硬件中生成，描述密钥和制造该密钥的设备的启动状态，并根据 Google 根和吊销列表在设备上进行验证。 它的力量是真实的，它的范围是精确的。 在下一部分中，我们将留在该范围内，并使用仪器将有效语句从合法设备移动到正在分析的设备。

绕过仪表

在上一节中，我们遵循了从密钥生成到后端判决的硬件证明。 现在我们使用的是已 root 的任务手机，引导加载程序已解锁，并且我们要分析的应用程序使用硬件认证作为入口。 在运行任何有趣的功能之前，应用程序会向 Android 密钥库请求经过验证的密钥，将证书链发送到其后端，然后等待绿灯。 在我们的设备上，该灯保持红色。

原因正是认证变得有用。 正如我们所看到的，RootOfTrust 结构存在于 hardwareEnforced 授权列表中，由安全环境而不是平台生成。 我们解锁的引导加载程序一目了然地写在此处：deviceLocked 为 false，verifiedBootState 未经过验证。 这条链子在其他方面是完全正品的。 它链接到 Google 根，签名有效，挑战匹配。 它只是讲述了有关我们设备的真相，而真相却让我们拒绝了。

演示客户端准确地展示了这一点。 后端回答 HTTP 400：deviceLocked false、verifiedBootState Unverified、StrongBox 支持的链等等。

因此，我们需要后端接收报告健康设备的链，而不放弃我们完成工作所需的根访问权限。 让我们看看我们的选择。

分析师能做什么？

由此引出三种路径，成本也截然不同。

  • 移至干净的设备并对应用程序进行中性处理。 我们刷新锁定的库存手机，安装目标，并使用仪器修补认证呼叫或其呼叫者。 这可行，但它抛弃了我们最初对手机进行root的原因。 我们失去了观察应用程序的立足点。 它还意味着在我们无法完全控制的设备上对抗应用程序附带的任何防篡改功能。
  • 攻击硬件或关键材料。 这是 Guardsquare 映射的地面：泄露的密钥箱、在 Keystore 层注入证明密钥的 TrickyStore 等工具以及 TEE 密钥提取 1。 这些技术非常强大，当它们发挥作用时，它们会从根本上击败证明。 它们还依赖于供应商可以撤销的泄露或提取的密钥，并且如果没有特定的漏洞或购买的密钥箱，它们中的大多数都是无法实现的。
  • 将证明转发到干净的设备。 我们保留已root的手机及其root访问权限。 第二部手机，干净且未经修改，生成与后端挑战绑定的真实证明，我们用钩子将该链拼接到目标流中。 我们既不攻击加密货币，也不攻击硬件，只攻击运行证明的位置。

第三条路径是本节的主题。 它是三者中最便宜的，它可以用商用电话完全复制，并且它停留在我们舒适的仪器世界中。

一口气想到的想法

真正干净的手机通过认证并不是绕过。 这是证明在履行其职责。 当我们获取干净手机的认证并使用它来应答我们已root的手机时，绕过就开始了。

该计划是一个接力。 在我们已root的手机上运行的目标应用程序将向其本地密钥库询问经过验证的密钥。 我们拦截该请求。 我们将后端的挑战转发给一个干净的手机，它运行自己的证明并向我们返回一个真实的证书链，由真正的安全硬件签名，并承载我们的挑战。 我们将该链返回给应用程序，就好像本地密钥库已生成它一样。 应用程序将其转发到后端。 后端看到一条真正的链、一个匹配的挑战和一个锁定的、经过验证的设备，然后进行验证。

没有什么是伪造的。 每张证书都是真实的。 我们只是简单地更换了生产它们的手机。

运动部件

为了使演示自包含，存储库提供了四个部分。 其中三个代表真正的参与，第四个是仪器本身。

https://github.com/quarkslab/android-hardware-attestation-demo
  • 后端 (backend/attestation_backend.py)，一个 Python 验证器。 它在 POST /nonce 上发出挑战，并在 POST /verify 上验证链。 它扮演目标应用程序服务器的角色。

接缝在哪里？

在钩住任何东西之前，我们需要知道我们要剪什么。 让我们阅读演示客户端中的诚实流程。 MainActivity 按顺序运行三个调用。

private fun attest(server: String): Report = try {
    val backend = BackendClient(server)

    val nonce = backend.requestNonce()
    // The backend encodes the nonce as unpadded base64url. The challenge is the raw value.
    val challenge = Base64.decode(nonce, Base64.URL_SAFE or Base64.NO_WRAP)

    val key = KeystoreAttestation(this).generateAttestedKey(challenge)
    val response = backend.verify(nonce, key.chainBase64)

    buildReport(nonce, key, response)
} catch (e: Exception) {
    Report(false, "LOCAL FAILURE", "${e.javaClass.simpleName}\n${e.message ?: "no message"}")
}

第一步向后端请求随机数。 第二步将随机数变成经过验证的密钥。 第三步将生成的链发回以进行判决。 有趣的工作发生在第二步，在 KeystoreAttestation 内部。

fun generateAttestedKey(challenge: ByteArray): AttestedKey {
    // ...
    val spec = KeyGenParameterSpec.Builder(
        KEY_ALIAS,
        KeyProperties.PURPOSE_SIGN or KeyProperties.PURPOSE_VERIFY
    )
        .setAlgorithmParameterSpec(ECGenParameterSpec("secp256r1"))
        .setDigests(KeyProperties.DIGEST_SHA256)
        .setAttestationChallenge(challenge)
        .setIsStrongBoxBacked(strongBox)
        .build()

    KeyPairGenerator.getInstance(KeyProperties.KEY_ALGORITHM_EC, "AndroidKeyStore").apply {
        initialize(spec)
        generateKeyPair()
    }
    // ... export chain with keyStore.getCertificateChain(KEY_ALIAS)
}

这就是整个硬件交互。 对 setAttestationChallenge 10 的调用将普通密钥生成转变为证明请求。 我们在这里传递的字节被逐字复制到 KeyDescription 的 attestationChallenge 字段中，这是在密钥生成时提供的质询。 这是绑定后端的新鲜度，稍后会根据它发出的随机数进行检查。

在干净的手机上，此方法返回报告锁定设备的链。 在我们取得 root 权限的手机上，它会返回一条链，报告解锁的链。 相同的代码，相同的密钥，不同的判决。 方法就是接缝。 所有特定于设备的内容都在其后面，并且其签名很小。

fun generateAttestedKey(challenge: ByteArray): AttestedKey

当一个挑战出现时，就会出现一条包裹在 AttestedKey 中的链。 如果我们可以用另一个设备上的链来应答这个调用，应用程序永远不会知道其中的区别。 这就是我们剪切的地方。

真实目标的注释。 在演示中，接缝是一个单一的整洁方法。 真正的应用程序很少提供这样的功能。 通用阻塞点位于下方，即进入时位于 KeyGenParameterSpec.Builder.setAttestationChallenge 处，出去时位于 java.security.KeyStore.getCertificateChain 处。 将这两者挂钩可以到达任何使用标准密钥库证明路径的应用程序，但代价是需要更多的管道来将挑战与链相关联。

干净的预言机

第二部手机在锁定的库存系统上运行服务器应用程序。 它的工作范围很窄。 给定一个随机数，生成与其绑定的证明链，并将其返回。

private fun buildKey(alias: String, challenge: ByteArray, strongBox: Boolean) {
    val spec = KeyGenParameterSpec.Builder(alias, KeyProperties.PURPOSE_SIGN)
        .setAlgorithmParameterSpec(ECGenParameterSpec("secp256r1"))
        .setDigests(KeyProperties.DIGEST_SHA256)
        .setAttestationChallenge(challenge)
        .setIsStrongBoxBacked(strongBox)
        .build()
    KeyPairGenerator.getInstance(KeyProperties.KEY_ALGORITHM_EC, KEYSTORE).apply {
        initialize(spec)
        generateKeyPair()
    }
}

这是故意与客户端生成相同的密钥。 区别在于它运行的设备。 这里 setAttestationChallenge 生成一条链，其 RootOfTrust 报告 deviceLocked true 和verifiedBootState Verified，因为这是该手机的真实状态。 服务器通过 HTTP 公开它。

POST /attest   { "nonce": "<base64url>" }
  -> { "nonce": "<base64url>", "chain": ["<der_base64>", ...], "chain_length": <int> }

一个细节使中继变得微不足道。 服务器对随机数进行解码，使用原始字节作为质询，并将相同的随机数字符串回显到链旁边。 它的响应正文是后端在 POST /verify 上期望的请求正文。 我们可以按原样转发它，无需重塑。

在干净的手机上，预言机是一个屏幕。 我们启动它，它监听本地网络，并准备好回答/证明任何随机数。 这里没有其他事情发生。 该设备仅借用其健康的硬件。

钩子

现在我们连接两部手机。 Frida 代理在已 root 的手机上运行并替换我们发现的接缝。 它足够短，可以完整阅读。

import Java from 'frida-java-bridge';

const PACKAGE = 'com.quarkslab.attestation.demo';

// android.util.Base64 flags: NO_PADDING(1) | NO_WRAP(2) | URL_SAFE(8).
// This reproduces the unpadded base64url the backend issues from POST /nonce.
const BASE64_URL = 1 | 2 | 8;

Java.perform(() => {
    const KeystoreAttestation = Java.use(`${PACKAGE}.KeystoreAttestation`);
    const AttestedKey = Java.use(`${PACKAGE}.AttestedKey`);
    const Base64 = Java.use('android.util.Base64');
    const ArrayList = Java.use('java.util.ArrayList');

    KeystoreAttestation.generateAttestedKey.implementation = function (challenge: any) {
        // challenge is the raw nonce bytes. Re-encode to the backend base64url form
        // so the clean device is queried with the exact nonce string it expects.
        const nonce = Base64.encodeToString(challenge, BASE64_URL);

        send({ event: 'attestation_request', nonce: nonce });

        let chain: string[] = [];
        const op = recv('response', (message: any) => {
            chain = (message.payload as string[]) ?? [];
        });
        op.wait();

        const remoteChain = ArrayList.$new();
        chain.forEach((cert) => remoteChain.add(cert));

        // AttestedKey(List<String> chainBase64, String requestedLevel, String? fallbackReason)
        return AttestedKey.$new(remoteChain, 'StrongBox (relayed)', null);
    };

    send({ event: 'ready', hook: `${PACKAGE}.KeystoreAttestation.generateAttestedKey` });
});

让我们按照弗里达的方式来阅读它。 Java.perform 为我们提供了一个在附加到 Android 运行时的线程上运行的回调，这是在接触任何 Java 类 13 之前所必需的。 java.use解析了我们需要的类，包括应用程序自己的KeystoreAttestation和AttestedKey。 然后，我们为generateAttestedKey.implementation分配一个新函数，它为以后的每个调用重新定义方法。

在替换过程中我们做了四件事。

我们接受交给我们的挑战字节，并使用标志 NO_PADDING | Base64.encodeToString 对它们重新编码。 NO_WRAP | URL_SAFE，即 1 | 2 | 8 11. 这将重建后端发出的确切的随机数字符串，因为后端使用未填充的 base64url 生成其随机数，并且客户端在传入时解码了相同的字符串。 往返是无损的。

我们通过 send 将随机数传递给控制器​​，然后在 receive('response',...) 上阻塞 接下来是 op.wait()。 send 将消息推送到控制器，recv 为回复注册一次性回调，wait 会阻塞挂钩线程，直到回复到达 1213。 这将异步消息交换转变为同步调用，这正是我们所需要的。 应用程序的线程必须不会返回，直到我们有一个链可以给它。

我们将中继的证书包装在 java.util.ArrayList 中，并使用 $new 构建 AttestedKey。 “StrongBox（中继）”标签是装饰性的，只有链对后端很重要。

重要的一行是不存在的一行。 我们从不调用原始的generateAttestedKey。 本地密钥库从未被触及，因此 root 后的手机永远不会产生其故障链。 该应用程序收到我们中继的 AttestedKey，但无法将其与本地密钥区分开，因为类型和形状是相同的。

Python端附加代理并在两部手机之间扮演快递员的角色。

def on_message(message, data):
    if message["type"] == "error":
        print(f"[!] agent error: {message.get('stack', message)}")
        return
    if message["type"] != "send":
        return

    payload = message["payload"]
    event = payload.get("event")
    # ...
    if event != "attestation_request":
        return

    nonce = payload.get("nonce")
    print(f"[*] Intercepted nonce {nonce}")

    chain = []
    try:

        body = response.json()
        if response.ok and "chain" in body:
            chain = body["chain"]
    except Exception as exc:
        print(f"[!] Server request failed: {exc}")

    # Always answer so the hooked thread never blocks, even on failure.
    script.post({"type": "response", "payload": chain})

当代理发送 attestation_request 时，控制器读取随机数，将其发布到干净设备的 /attest 端点，并使用 script.post 12 将返回的链发布回代理。 该回复就是解锁手机上的 op.wait() 的原因。 即使出现故障，控制器也始终会做出响应，因此网络错误会降级为空链和干净的拒绝，而不是冻结的应用程序线程。

把它放在一起

当后端运行时，干净的服务器应用程序在第二部手机上打开，并且控制器连接到目标，我们点击证明按钮。 这是完整的往返行程。

client    generateAttestedKey(challenge)          [hooked]

回到客户端，同一个按钮现在讲述了不同的故事。 相同的应用程序，相同的代码，但判决翻转为“证明有效”。 报告显示verified_boot_state已验证且device_locked为true，并且请求的级别被标记为StrongBox（中继）。 这些值现在来自干净的手机，而不是我们的。

到达后端的链是由锁定的、经过验证的手机上的真正安全硬件生成的。 它承载着我们后端的挑战。 因此它通过了验证器所做的每一项检查，并且值得从后端自己的代码中遍历它们以了解为什么它们都没有触发。

该链构建了一条通往 Google 根的有效路径，并且每个签名都经过检查。 挑战绑定成立，因为链中的 attestationChallenge 是我们未更改地转发的随机数。

# Bind the attestation to the challenge we issued.
if attestation["challenge_b64"] != nonce:
    # ... rejected

设备策略是我们 root 后的手机可能会死机的地方，也是中继拯救我们的地方。 后端仅从 hardwareEnforced 列表中读取 RootOfTrust，这与它应该的完全一样，因为软件列表可以由受损平台写入。

state = attestation["verified_boot_state"]
if state == "absent":
    return "RootOfTrust missing from the tee_enforced authorization list"
if attestation["device_locked"] is not True:
    return "Bootloader is unlocked (deviceLocked is false)"
if state != "Verified":
    return f"Verified Boot state is {state}, expected Verified"

该错误字符串中的 tee_enforced 是硬件强制列表的 Keymaster 时代名称。 KeyMint 从证明版本 300 开始将其重命名为 hardwareEnforced，并且当前的 AOSP 架构始终使用该名称。 同一领域，两个名字。

在我们自己的链上，device_locked 将为 false，并且这会返回错误。 在中继链上，这是真的，并且状态已验证，因为这些值来自干净手机的安全硬件。 出于同样的原因，硬件支持的检查也会通过，证明安全级别是 StrongBox 或 TrustedEnvironment，而不是 Software。 判决有效。

为什么后端无法判断

后台到底能看到什么？ 这就是中继工作的原因，也是缓解措施必须改变的地方。

证书链证明密钥存在于锁定的、经过验证的设备上的真正安全硬件中，并且该硬件遇到了我们的挑战。 它不能证明哪部手机现在正在与后端通信。 KeyDescription 中没有任何字段将证明绑定到传输、会话或呈现它的设备。 随机数是唯一的新鲜度信号，我们忠实地转发了它。 从后端的角度来看，中继链和本地链是相同的字节。

这与 Guardsquare 记录的远程密钥证明 1 的形状相同，即在一台设备上生成并从另一台设备上呈现的一条链。 与他们描述的变体不同，我们的变体没有隐藏密钥盒，也没有修补启动链。 它转发来自真正干净设备的真实证明，绑定到真正的挑战，仅此而已。

简单继电器停止的地方

我们的中继依赖于后端无法完成的两件事，并且将它们命名直接指向缓解措施。

第一个是决定性的。 后端从不检查链被发布到哪个应用程序。 我们的链是在干净的手机上由与目标不同的应用程序生成的，证明也是如此。 应用程序身份写入到 attestationApplicationId 下的证书中。 我们的后端根本不会读取它。 一旦它这样做，并将该字段与它期望的应用程序进行比较，我们构建的链就会被拒绝。 那次检查就是我们的中继停止的地方，而且它是所有检查中最便宜的。

第二个更深。 中继假设证明是一次性门。 应用程序在启动时或登录期间进行一次证明，后端会验证链和随机数，授予访问权限，然后继续。 令人惊讶的是，这种假设经常成立，当它成立时，中继就足够了。 当后端要求客户端稍后在同一会话中证明它拥有经过验证的私钥时，它就会中断。 经过验证的密钥存在于干净的手机上，而不是我们root过的手机上。 我们传递的是一条链，而不是一把钥匙。 如果后端发送一个新值以使用该密钥进行签名并检查签名，我们的测试设备将无法自行应答。 我们还必须中继签名操作，让干净的手机处于循环状态以处理每条签名消息。 一次性信使变成了一个活生生的代理人，更重、更脆弱，但并没有停止。

两者都是防守者可以压迫的接缝。 我们将在下一节中讨论它们，首先是决定性且廉价的部分。

减轻

现在我们换椅子并从后端查看继电器。 问题很简单。 什么检查可以阻止我们自己的绕过？ 我们首先采取最便宜的缓解措施，并且我们让每一个措施都保持诚实。 对于每个提案，我们都会说明它迫使攻击者做什么，以及它不能解决什么。

前面有一点需要注意。 第一个缓解措施已经针对我们自己的中继进行了测试。 但是，它的代码不随本文一起提供。 同伴后端故意将其遗漏，因此中继有一个可以通过的门。 我们单独运行检查并确认它拒绝中继链。 第二个是设计方案。 我们对其进行推理并指出它所依据的标准，但我们没有构建它，也没有测试它。 我们在每个部分和综合表中再次标记这一点，以便读者可以从蓝图中区分经过测试的控件。

值得明确的是中继利用了什么。 这不是证明机制的弱点。 我们转发的链是真实的，签名是有效的，硬件说的是实话。 让我们通过的是后端验证链而不检查它是发给谁的。 由于两个间隙，继电器起作用了。

  1. 该链携带请求证明的应用程序的身份，但基线后端永远不会根据它期望与之通信的应用程序来检查它。
  2. 它验证客户端从未被要求使用的密钥，因此从其他设备中继的链永远不会受到质疑。

第一个差距是真正的差距，缩小它才是真正的缓解措施。 第二个只会增加分析师的成本。 我们按这个顺序接受它们。

将证明绑定到您的应用程序

证明扩展已包含生成密钥的应用程序的身份。 attestationApplicationId 字段（AuthorizationList 中的标记 [709]）保存包名称、应用程序签名证书的 SHA-256 摘要以及版本代码 214。 我们的后端从不读取它。 谷歌自己的发行指南明确指出，包名和签名来自持有者，必须独立获取和检查20。 这个遗漏就是让中继通过的原因，因为该链来自不同的应用程序。

它的值是一个 DER 编码的结构，嵌套在扩展名 1514 中：

AttestationApplicationId ::= SEQUENCE {
    packageInfos      SET OF AttestationPackageInfo,
    signatureDigests  SET OF OCTET_STRING,
}

AttestationPackageInfo ::= SEQUENCE {
    packageName  OCTET_STRING,
    version      INTEGER,
}

人们很容易将应用程序身份想象为客户端发送到链旁边的字段。 那不是它居住的地方。 它位于标签 [709] 下，位于与质询和信任根相同的证明扩展内，后端将其从证书中解析出来。 packageName 是应用程序包名称，signatureDigests 是应用程序签名证书的 SHA-256 摘要。 平台从调用generateKey的应用程序中填充这两个值，因此在具有健康启动状态的设备上，调用者无法选择它们。

有一个问题，这就是此检查首先放置但不是唯一的原因。 attestationApplicationId 位于 softwareEnforced 列表中，由 Android 平台填充，而不是由安全硬件填充。 仅当生成软件强制值的设备运行符合 Android 平台安全模型的操作系统时，即其引导加载程序被锁定且其 verifyBootState 为 Verified 2，软件强制值才可以被信任。 在直接 root 的手机上，没有中继，受感染的平台可以在这里写入任何内容。

这个警告正是检查对中继起作用的原因。 我们的后端已经拒绝任何硬件强制 RootOfTrust 不报告锁定的、经过验证的设备的链。

if attestation["device_locked"] is not True:
    return "Bootloader is unlocked (deviceLocked is false)"
if state != "Verified":
    return f"Verified Boot state is {state}, expected Verified"

一旦检查通过，链就会在操作系统满足安全模型的设备上生成。 在此类设备上，软件强制值是值得信赖的。 所以这两个检查组成了。 硬件强制启动状态为平台提供担保，现在值得信赖的平台为应用程序身份提供担保。

具体来说，后端在解析完扩展名后，添加了一项比较。

# Illustrative. Not yet implemented in attestation_backend.py.
EXPECTED_PACKAGE = "com.quarkslab.attestation.demo"
EXPECTED_SIGNER_SHA256 = "…"  # SHA-256 of our release signing certificate

if attestation["application_package"] != EXPECTED_PACKAGE:
    return "Attestation was generated by a different application"
if EXPECTED_SIGNER_SHA256 not in attestation["application_signatures"]:
    return "Attestation application signature does not match"

在我们的中继中，链是由运行 com.quarkslab.attestation.server 的干净预言机生成的。 它的诚实平台将该包和它自己的签名摘要写入该字段。 比较失败，链被拒绝。 分析师也无法围绕它重新包装。 干净的验证启动操作系统将报告真实身份，并且如果没有目标的私有签名密钥，则无法匹配签名证书摘要。 我们在单独的测试中添加了此检查，它拒绝了中继链。 这种单一的比较杀死了我们构建的跨应用程序中继，即使交付的后端故意将其遗漏。

它本身并不能证明设备的完整性。 将其视为与应用程序的绑定，而不是完整性信号，并始终将其与上面的硬件强制启动状态检查配对。

将证明绑定到实时密钥

应用程序检查会关闭我们演示的继电器。 意志坚定的分析师还能渡过难关吗？ 仅通过从同一应用程序的干净实例生成证明，以便包和签名摘要匹配。 这比听起来更难。 这意味着在干净且经过验证的设备上驱动真正的目标应用程序，以证明分析师选择的挑战并交回原始链。 干净且经过验证的设备正是您无法检测的设备。 没有简单的方法来注入随机数或导出链。 对该设备进行 root 检测会破坏其经过验证的启动状态并使认证失败。 如果没有密钥箱或 TEE bug（这是我们预留的硬件路径），同一应用程序中继就无法实现。

假设分析师无论如何都会到达那里。 更深层次的问题是后端检查证书并且从不要求客户端使用它认证的密钥。 解决办法是拥有证明。 有效证明后，后端要求客户端在同一会话内使用经过证明的私钥签署新的服务器质询，并验证签名 16。 这是移动证明设计在证明之后放置的断言步骤，与硬件支持的身份验证器 17 使用的相同的先证明后断言模式。

这不会关闭继电器。 经过验证的密钥存在于干净的设备上，因此分析人员通过将每个签名操作转发给它来回答证明。 一次性快递员成为实时代理，必须在整个会话期间保持在线。 这是运营成本、每个签名的延迟以及必须保持可访问的设备，而不是障碍。 它会减慢分析师的速度，但不会将他们拒之门外。

我们描述了这种缓解措施，但我们不交付它。 配套后端仅实现上面的应用程序绑定。 拥有证明是这里的一个设计提案，经过推理但未实施，也未针对我们的中继进行测试。

结论

我们着手做两件事。 了解 Android 硬件认证证明了什么，并在它阻止分析时绕过它。 两者都完成了，并且它们指向同一个教训。

机制本身是健全的。 TEE 或 StrongBox 中生成的密钥由设备无法选择或伪造的密钥进行签名，该链会爬升到 Google 根，并且 RootOfTrust 会报告启动状态，而无需请求平台许可。 在我们root过的手机上，机器完全按照设计工作。 它说的是实话，而真相却把我们拒之门外。 没有密码学可以破解，我们也没有尝试。

我们打破的是一个假设。 后端将签名的证书视为前面的手机运行状况良好的证据。 它不是。 这证明某些手机在某个地方拥有健康的硬件并且曾经遇到过我们的挑战。 我们提供了那部电话。 一个干净的设备响应了认证，它的真实链通过 Frida 钩子传回，后端验证了一个它从未遇到过的设备。 我们既没有更改密钥，也没有更改启动状态。 我们改变了被问到的人。

这是道德，而不是特定于证明。 硬件保证的强度取决于使用它的协议。 证明在某个时刻对设备上的密钥进行认证。 它没有说明哪个应用程序请求了它，也没有说明该密钥是否再次使用过。 一个只读取“有效链，健康设备”并打开大门的后端已经将硬件保证变成了形式。 缩小差距并不需要更好的硅。 它要求后端将证明绑定到请求的应用程序。 这张支票既便宜又乏味，这可能就是它经常被忽略的原因。
